__doc: Player archetypes. `bias` is added to each attribute at generation (before the 2-3 strengths / 2-3 weaknesses are spiked on top). `strengthPool` and `weaknessPool` bias WHICH attributes get spiked or tanked, so an IGL is unlikely to roll a huge Aim spike. Add your own archetype by copying a block and giving it a new id.

archetypes.name: W-Key Aggro
archetypes.blurb: Sees a player, hears a player, presses W. Wins games off raw mechanics, throws games off raw impatience.

archetypes.name: IGL
archetypes.blurb: Calls the rotates, reads the zone, keeps the trio alive. Rarely the one topping the elim charts.

archetypes.name: Support-Anchor
archetypes.blurb: Holds the piece, carries the mats, takes the trade so the star gets out. Unspectacular and irreplaceable.

archetypes.name: Zone Player
archetypes.blurb: Never takes a fight they do not have to. Lives in the top 10 and lets the lobby kill itself.

archetypes.name: Flex
archetypes.blurb: Slots into any trio. Fewer glaring holes, fewer god-tier highs.

attributes.__doc: Display names and tooltips for the 11 visible ratings. Order here is the order shown in the UI.

aim.name: Aim
aim.desc: Fights won. Raw gunplay in a box fight or an open-field spray.

buildSpeed.name: Build Speed
buildSpeed.desc: Mechanics under pressure. Getting the wall up before the shot lands.

editing.name: Editing
editing.desc: Fast plays, edit courses, cone-and-confirm windows.

pieceControl.name: Piece Control
pieceControl.desc: Taking and holding the other trio pieces. The endgame skill.

gameSense.name: Game Sense
gameSense.desc: Zone reads. Knowing when to fight and when to rotate.

lootPathing.name: Loot Pathing
lootPathing.desc: Early game efficiency. Mats, shields and a clean path out.

endgame.name: Endgame
endgame.desc: Final circles, height retakes, surviving the last five teams.

clutch.name: Clutch
clutch.desc: 1v3s and low HP moments. Some players get better as it gets worse.

consistency.name: Consistency
consistency.desc: How much they vary match to match. LOW = boom or bust.

stamina.name: Stamina
stamina.desc: Drop-off over a long session. Matters most in matches 6-10.

comms.name: Comms
comms.desc: Raises the whole trio. Callouts, calm, information.
